title: 在国宴上穿裤子的美国第一夫人
description: VANESSA FRIEDMAN2026年9月26日周四，在白宫举行的国宴前，特朗普总统、梅拉尼娅·特朗普、习近平主席及夫人彭丽媛合影留念。 Doug Mills/The New York Times Well, that was a surprise. 这可真是出人意料。 In what may have been a first for an American first lady, Melania Trump did something at the state dinner for China’s leader on Thursday night that none of her predecessors had likely done before: She wore pants. 在周四晚为中国领导人举行的国宴上，梅拉尼娅·特朗普做了一件可能是美国第一夫人史上前所未有、她的各位前任大概都没做过的事：她穿了裤子。 Pants! To a black-tie banquet. Especially a black-tie banquet taking place at a highly sensitive time in global geopolitics and economic relations. 裤子！还是穿去参加正装晚宴。更何况，这场正装晚宴正值全球地缘政治和经济关系极为敏感的时期。 Specifically, Mrs. Trump wore a pair of peony-print Dolce & Gabbana black tuxedo pants with a white Saint Laurent blouse displaying an enormous bow to join her husband in welcoming the Chinese president, Xi Jinping; his wife, Peng Liyuan; and assorted dignitaries (including many tech executives) to the formal occasion. 具体来说，特朗普夫人穿了一条印有牡丹图案的杜嘉班纳黑色礼服长裤，搭配一件带有巨大蝴蝶结的圣罗兰白色衬衫。她与丈夫一起出席这个正式场合，迎接中国国家主席习近平、其夫人彭丽媛以及各界要人（包括许多科技高管）。 The peony print on the pants may have been a nod to that flower’s importance in Chinese culture, where it is a symbol of beauty, wealth and happiness. In the end though, that subtle gesture was less significant than the norm-busting choice of the pants themselves on an occasion that has traditionally been synonymous with elaborate gowns. Or at least evening skirts. 裤装上的牡丹图案或许是在致意这种花在中国文化中的重要地位，在中国，它是美丽、财富和幸福的象征。不过，在这样一个传统上与华丽礼服（或至少是晚礼服裙）画等号的场合，这种微妙的致敬远不如选择长裤这一打破常规的举动本身更有意义。 Pants for evening is no longer a radical idea in most situations, but in a city that has become the last bastion of the suit and tie, where staid rules about fashion and the clothing that is fit for office still apply, they were a statement. 在大多数情况下，晚宴穿裤装已不再是一个激进的想法，但在这个已成为西装领结最后堡垒的城市，在有关时尚和职场着装的古板规则依然适用的地方，这个选择就成为一种宣言。 Especially in contrast with the more classic dress of Ms. Peng — a long gown with a Mandarin collar in red, China’s color of prosperity — as well as Mr. Trump’s tuxedo and Mr. Xi’s Zhongshan suit, standard choices both. (Not to mention the apparently matching navy suits and magenta ties they wore during their meeting earlier in the day.) 特别是，这与彭丽媛更为经典的着装形成鲜明对比——彭丽媛身穿中式立领红色长礼服，红色在中国象征着繁荣——还有特朗普的无尾礼服和习近平的中山装，两者都是标准的选择）。（更不用说他们两人在当天早些时候会面时所穿、看似很搭配的海军蓝西装和洋红色领带。） 梅拉尼娅·特朗普身着杜嘉班纳长裤和圣罗兰衬衫，与身着经典红色礼服的彭丽媛一同步入国宴现场。 When it comes to Melania Trump, however, the pants were also entirely on brand. They reflected the first lady’s continued reluctance to conform to archetypal expectations for first spouses. 然而，就梅拉尼娅·特朗普而言，裤装也完全符合她的个人风格。这反映出这位第一夫人一如既往地不愿顺从人们对第一配偶这一角色的刻板期待。 And they underscored once again the individual brand Mrs. Trump has been building since the release of her documentary earlier this year, with its focus on slick black-and-white graphics and luxury labels, on-screen as in her wardrobe. (That they also matched the pandas Mr. Xi offered to the Atlanta zoo as “envoys of friendship” was probably a coincidence.) 这也再次凸显了特朗普夫人自今年早些时候她的纪录片发布以来一直在打造的个人品牌形象，无论是银幕上还是她的衣橱里，都以精致的黑白图形和奢侈品牌为特色。（至于这样的打扮刚好与习近平作为“友谊的使者”赠送给亚特兰大动物园的大熊猫相呼应，大概只是个巧合。） Indeed, a Dolce & Gabbana pantsuit has become a uniform of sorts for the first lady since her husband returned to office. She wore Dolce for her official portrait in 2025 (the one that made her look like chairman of the board), to the White House dinner with governors the same year and to the State of the Union address earlier this year. 事实上，自从她丈夫重返白宫以来，杜嘉班纳的裤装已经成为这位第一夫人的某种制服。她在2025年拍摄官方肖像时（那张让她看起来像董事会主席的照片）、在同年各州州长出席的白宫晚宴上，以及在今年早些时候的国情咨文演讲中，穿的都是杜嘉班纳。 The look suggests that she views her role less like that of the hostess of the nation and more like that of an executive in a giant corporation. The buttoned-up styles also guard against the intrusive eyes and demands of the watching world and the country the first family represents. 这种造型表明，她将自己的角色更多地视为一家巨型企业的高管，而非国家的女主人。这种严谨的风格也帮她抵御外界窥探的目光与种种要求——这一切既来自注视着她的世界，也来自第一家庭所代表的国家。 周四，第一夫人身着亚历山大·麦昆套装。周三，第一夫人身着纪梵希细条纹西装，在安德鲁斯联合基地迎接彭丽媛。 You could see it with the giant bow on the blouse Mrs. Trump wore to the state dinner, which jutted out like a shield from the shirt’s equally protective high neck. You could see it in the military-style charcoal Alexander McQueen skirt suit she wore earlier in the day to tour the Smithsonian alongside Ms. Peng, with the jacket’s officer collar and side closure. And you could see it in the Givenchy pinstriped suit she wore to accompany her husband to Joint Base Andrews for the arrival of the Chinese leader. 从特朗普夫人国宴所穿衬衫上的巨大蝴蝶结可以看出这一点，它像盾牌一样，从同样具有保护性的衬衫高领处突出。你可以从她当天早些时候陪同彭丽媛参观史密森尼学会时穿的军装风炭灰色亚历山大·麦昆裙装中看出这一点，那件外套带有军官领和侧边纽扣。你还可以从她陪同丈夫前往安德鲁斯联合基地迎接中国领导人到来时穿的纪梵希细条纹套装中看出这一点。 That’s why, though it would be nice to interpret Mrs. Trump’s choice of pants as a win for women’s liberation everywhere (really, it is ridiculous that it took until 2026 for a first lady to wear pants to a state dinner), it seems unlikely that the motivating factor was gender advancement. Rather than, say, personal priorities. 正因如此，尽管将特朗普夫人选择裤装解读为全球女性解放的胜利，这样的说法听起来很美好（说真的，直到2026年才有一位第一夫人穿裤装出席国宴，这太荒唐了），但其背后的动机似乎不太可能是为了推动性别进步，倒不如说是出于个人事项的优先考量。 Vanessa Friedman自2014年以来一直担任时报时尚总监和首席时尚评论家。

title: 白宫国宴：AI巨头与习近平共进晚餐，特朗普脱稿演讲
description: SHAWN McCREESH2026年9月26日周四晚，特朗普总统和中国国家主席习近平携夫人出席了在白宫举行的国宴。 Doug Mills/The New York Times It was just a fun little dinner for the people deciding the future of humanity. 这不过是为决定人类未来者举办的一场轻松愉快的小型晚宴。 The amount of power concentrated at the head table alone was dizzying. The American president and the Chinese president, dining by candlelight with Elon Musk, Jensen Huang and Tim Cook, all of them sitting in the State Dining room of the White House at this moment that many in Silicon Valley warn could be the last before mankind stumbles into the A.I. apocalypse. 光是主桌上汇聚的权力就令人目眩。美国总统和中国国家主席与埃隆·马斯克、黄仁勋和蒂姆·库克在烛光下共进晚餐。此刻，他们全都坐在白宫的国宴厅里，而硅谷的许多人警告说，这可能是人类陷入人工智能末日之前的最后时刻。 周四晚上的国宴场面极为隆重。 Standing before a room chockablock with A.I. moguls, billionaires and politicians, President Trump decided to depart from his prepared remarks. Now that he finally had these people together in one place, he could talk about his important plans. The ones he’s been working on nonstop ever since he returned to the White House. 站在挤满人工智能大亨、亿万富翁和政界人士的房间里，特朗普总统决定脱离准备好的讲稿。既然他终于把这些人聚在了一起，他就可以谈谈自己的重要计划——自从他重返白宫以来就一直不遗余力推进的计划。 “If I could go off-script, just for a second,” he said. “请允许我脱稿一下，就一小会儿，”他说。 The sound of rich people clapping filled the room. Suspense! 富人们热烈的掌声响彻全场。有悬念！ “I just want to say …” the president continued. “我只是想说……”总统继续道。 “… I’d like to invite everyone in the room to visit through that beautiful curtain in the back — The door, it’s all lit up, and looks beautiful. It’s one year away from completion, the new ballroom that you’ve heard about.” “……我想邀请在座各位穿过后面那道美丽的帷幕去参观——那扇门，亮着灯，看起来很漂亮。你们听说过的那个新宴会厅，距离完工还有一年的时间。” Oh. He was inviting them to take a walk through the construction site in back of the house. 哦。原来他是在邀请大家去白宫后面的建筑工地走走。 “You’ll be the first people to step foot on that,” he told guests including Jeff Bezos, Mark Zuckerberg and Sam Altman, “and we’ll do that maybe after we’re finished with the entertainment tonight.” “你们是第一批踏上那里的人，”他对包括杰夫·贝佐斯、马克·扎克伯格和萨姆·奥特曼在内的宾客们说，“也许等今晚的娱乐活动结束，我们就去那儿转转。” There was not a single mention of A.I. in his speech. Mr. Trump doesn’t buy into the A.I. panic. He insists it’s mostly just a problem of branding. A.I. needs better P.R. 在他的讲话中，根本没有提及人工智能。特朗普先生并不相信人工智能恐慌。他坚持认为这主要只是一个品牌包装问题。人工智能需要更好的公关。 If any of the tech titans and members of Chinese Politburo who showed up to the White House used the state visit to get on the same page about the direction of this terrifying new technology, they haven’t shared their designs with the public. This was a roomful of people who have many disagreements about the way forward. 就算出现在白宫的任何科技巨头和中国政治局委员利用这次国事访问，就这项可怕的新技术的发展方向达成了什么共识，他们也没有向公众透露他们的构想。这个房间里的人对于未来的发展方向存在诸多分歧。 在周四晚上的国宴上，特朗普邀请宾客参观新建宴会厅的施工现场。 The American president, for his part, just seemed happy to be playing maître d’ to the mighty. 就美国总统而言，他似乎只是乐于充当这些权贵们的领班角色。 “You will see something that I think you will really love,” Mr. Trump told them about the ballroom site. “Tonight, if we had it, we would have had way more than a thousand people, with standing room only. And this room has about 145, that’s about it.” “你们会看到一些我觉得你们会非常喜欢的东西，”特朗普在谈到宴会厅场地时对他们说。“今晚，如果我们有那个场地，到场人数肯定远远超过一千人，挤得水泄不通。而这个厅只能装145人左右，就这样了。” “Anybody who wants to walk into a construction site that’s nice and clean and sparkling, it’s our honor to have you do so,” he said. “This is in honor of President Xi, Madam Peng.” “任何想要走进一个整洁、干净、闪闪发光的建筑工地的人，我们都很荣幸能请你来参观，”他说。“这是为了向习近平主席和彭夫人致敬。” Mr. Trump never seems more pleased than when he is hosting wealthy and powerful people at his table. The aspects of the job that so clearly delight him concern pageantry and set design, and Mr. Xi’s visit provided opportunities for plenty of it. 特朗普最开心的时候似乎就是邀请富人和权贵坐在他的餐桌旁。这份工作中最能让他乐在其中的莫过于盛大的仪式和精心设计的场景，而习近平的访问为此提供了大量的机会。 Earlier in the day, Mr. Trump took Mr. Xi around the back to show off a new helipad and the slick new driveway. “He’s an expert on stone, aside from many others, and he loves good granite,” Mr. Trump told reporters as the pair walked back inside. 当天早些时候，特朗普带着习近平绕到后面，向他展示新建的直升机停机坪和光鲜的新车道。“他精通很多领域，还是石材专家，而且他特别喜欢上好的花岗岩，”两人走回室内时，特朗普对记者说。 特朗普带领习近平参观了新建的直升机停机坪。 Mr. Xi announced a gift of two giant pandas, named Ping Ping and Fu Shuang, who will live at the Atlanta zoo. At the dinner, Mr. Trump unveiled a rather large statue of a bald eagle to give to the Chinese autocrat. 习近平宣布赠送两只大熊猫作为礼物，它们名叫“平平”和“福双”，将会生活在亚特兰大动物园。在晚宴上，特朗普揭幕了一座相当大的白头海雕雕像，作为送给这位中国专制统治者的礼物。 “We hope it’ll find a nice place, a wonderful place, in Beijing,” Mr. Trump said. “我们希望它能在北京找到一个好地方，一个绝好的位置，”特朗普说。 Sadly for Mr. Trump, almost none of this made it onto the television networks he watches so closely. The Chinese state visit has collided with the consequences of the decision he made in a fit of pique last Friday to ban CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House campus. A judge ordered the Trump administration to let the banned reporters back Thursday, but the TV networks are still refusing to take Mr. Trump’s carnival live. Until his administration formally agrees to let CNN back into the White House TV pool rotation, he is not going to see those blinking red lights he loves so much. 令特朗普遗憾的是，这一切几乎都没有出现在他密切关注的电视上。此次中国国家元首的访问恰好与他上周五一气之下做出的决定所带来的后果发生了冲突——他当时下令禁止CNN、MS NOW和Politico进入白宫区域。周四，一名法官下令特朗普政府允许被禁记者重返白宫，但各大电视网仍拒绝直播特朗普的这场嘉年华。除非他的政府正式同意让CNN重新加入白宫电视联合采访团轮换，否则他将无法看到那些他深深喜爱的闪烁红灯。 在国宴上，双方互赠了礼物，特朗普总统向这位中国领导人赠送了一尊白头海雕雕像。 Shortly before the dinner began, he posted one of his diatribes on his website. 就在晚宴开始前不久，他在自己的网站上发布了一篇抨击文章。 CNN and MS NOW were “fake,” he wrote, because they wouldn’t cover “one of the Biggest and Most Beautiful Events to take place in many years, the arrival at the White House of the Highly Respected President of China, Xi Jinping, and his beautiful wife, Madam Peng." 他写道，CNN和MS NOW是“假新闻”，因为它们拒绝报道“多年来最盛大、最美丽的活动之一——备受尊敬的中国国家主席习近平和他美丽的妻子彭夫人抵达白宫。” The president continued: “The event was magnificent — Actually made for Television but, because they’re Fake News, and because they knew how good it would be, they didn’t want credit to be given to ‘TRUMP,’ they refused to be there. That’s why they have such poor Ratings.” 总统还写道：“这场活动非常盛大——实际上就是为电视量身定做的，但因为它们是假新闻，而且因为它们知道这会有多棒，它们不想把功劳归于‘特朗普’，所以它们拒绝出席。所以它们的收视率才这么糟糕。” He concluded: “Tonight’s State Dinner at the White House, for President Xi, will be spectacular! The Media will be in attendance.” 他总结道：“今晚在白宫为习近平主席举行的国宴将会非常壮观！媒体届时也会到场。” Yes, the White House complex was crawling with journalists Thursday evening as Mr. Xi pulled up to the front door of the residence. But, in the spirit of solidarity with those targeted by Mr. Trump’s ban, some just ignored the spectacle. 是的，周四傍晚，当习近平抵达白宫官邸正门时，白宫建筑群内确实到处都是记者。但是，为了声援那些遭到特朗普禁令针对的人士，一些人对这个壮观的场面无动于衷。 中国国家主席习近平的专车驶过白宫西翼外的媒体记者群。 Shawn McCreesh是时报白宫记者，报道特朗普政府新闻。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。
content: SHAWN McCREESH 2026年9月26日 周四晚，特朗普总统和中国国家主席习近平携夫人出席了在白宫举行的国宴。 Doug Mills/The New York Times It was just a fun little dinner for the people deciding the future of humanity. 这不过是为决定人类未来者举办的一场轻松愉快的小型晚宴。 The amount of power concentrated at the head table alone was dizzying. The American president and the Chinese president, dining by candlelight with Elon Musk, Jensen Huang and Tim Cook, all of them sitting in the State Dining room of the White House at this moment that many in Silicon Valley warn could be the last before mankind stumbles into the A.I. apocalypse. 光是主桌上汇聚的权力就令人目眩。美国总统和中国国家主席与埃隆·马斯克、黄仁勋和蒂姆·库克在烛光下共进晚餐。此刻，他们全都坐在白宫的国宴厅里，而硅谷的许多人警告说，这可能是人类陷入人工智能末日之前的最后时刻。 周四晚上的国宴场面极为隆重。 Standing before a room chockablock with A.I. moguls, billionaires and politicians, President Trump decided to depart from his prepared remarks. Now that he finally had these people together in one place, he could talk about his important plans. The ones he’s been working on nonstop ever since he returned to the White House. 站在挤满人工智能大亨、亿万富翁和政界人士的房间里，特朗普总统决定脱离准备好的讲稿。既然他终于把这些人聚在了一起，他就可以谈谈自己的重要计划——自从他重返白宫以来就一直不遗余力推进的计划。 “If I could go off-script, just for a second,” he said. “请允许我脱稿一下，就一小会儿，”他说。 The sound of rich people clapping filled the room. Suspense! 富人们热烈的掌声响彻全场。有悬念！ “I just want to say …” the president continued. “我只是想说……”总统继续道。 “… I’d like to invite everyone in the room to visit through that beautiful curtain in the back — The door, it’s all lit up, and looks beautiful. It’s one year away from completion, the new ballroom that you’ve heard about.” “……我想邀请在座各位穿过后面那道美丽的帷幕去参观——那扇门，亮着灯，看起来很漂亮。你们听说过的那个新宴会厅，距离完工还有一年的时间。” Oh. He was inviting them to take a walk through the construction site in back of the house. 哦。原来他是在邀请大家去白宫后面的建筑工地走走。 “You’ll be the first people to step foot on that,” he told guests including Jeff Bezos, Mark Zuckerberg and Sam Altman, “and we’ll do that maybe after we’re finished with the entertainment tonight.” “你们是第一批踏上那里的人，”他对包括杰夫·贝佐斯、马克·扎克伯格和萨姆·奥特曼在内的宾客们说，“也许等今晚的娱乐活动结束，我们就去那儿转转。” There was not a single mention of A.I. in his speech. Mr. Trump doesn’t buy into the A.I. panic. He insists it’s mostly just a problem of branding. A.I. needs better P.R. 在他的讲话中，根本没有提及人工智能。特朗普先生并不相信人工智能恐慌。他坚持认为这主要只是一个品牌包装问题。人工智能需要更好的公关。 If any of the tech titans and members of Chinese Politburo who showed up to the White House used the state visit to get on the same page about the direction of this terrifying new technology, they haven’t shared their designs with the public. This was a roomful of people who have many disagreements about the way forward. 就算出现在白宫的任何科技巨头和中国政治局委员利用这次国事访问，就这项可怕的新技术的发展方向达成了什么共识，他们也没有向公众透露他们的构想。这个房间里的人对于未来的发展方向存在诸多分歧。 在周四晚上的国宴上，特朗普邀请宾客参观新建宴会厅的施工现场。 The American president, for his part, just seemed happy to be playing maître d’ to the mighty. 就美国总统而言，他似乎只是乐于充当这些权贵们的领班角色。 “You will see something that I think you will really love,” Mr. Trump told them about the ballroom site. “Tonight, if we had it, we would have had way more than a thousand people, with standing room only. And this room has about 145, that’s about it.” “你们会看到一些我觉得你们会非常喜欢的东西，”特朗普在谈到宴会厅场地时对他们说。“今晚，如果我们有那个场地，到场人数肯定远远超过一千人，挤得水泄不通。而这个厅只能装145人左右，就这样了。” “Anybody who wants to walk into a construction site that’s nice and clean and sparkling, it’s our honor to have you do so,” he said. “This is in honor of President Xi, Madam Peng.” “任何想要走进一个整洁、干净、闪闪发光的建筑工地的人，我们都很荣幸能请你来参观，”他说。“这是为了向习近平主席和彭夫人致敬。” Mr. Trump never seems more pleased than when he is hosting wealthy and powerful people at his table. The aspects of the job that so clearly delight him concern pageantry and set design, and Mr. Xi’s visit provided opportunities for plenty of it. 特朗普最开心的时候似乎就是邀请富人和权贵坐在他的餐桌旁。这份工作中最能让他乐在其中的莫过于盛大的仪式和精心设计的场景，而习近平的访问为此提供了大量的机会。 Earlier in the day, Mr. Trump took Mr. Xi around the back to show off a new helipad and the slick new driveway. “He’s an expert on stone, aside from many others, and he loves good granite,” Mr. Trump told reporters as the pair walked back inside. 当天早些时候，特朗普带着习近平绕到后面，向他展示新建的直升机停机坪和光鲜的新车道。“他精通很多领域，还是石材专家，而且他特别喜欢上好的花岗岩，”两人走回室内时，特朗普对记者说。 特朗普带领习近平参观了新建的直升机停机坪。 Mr. Xi announced a gift of two giant pandas, named Ping Ping and Fu Shuang, who will live at the Atlanta zoo. At the dinner, Mr. Trump unveiled a rather large statue of a bald eagle to give to the Chinese autocrat. 习近平宣布赠送两只大熊猫作为礼物，它们名叫“平平”和“福双”，将会生活在亚特兰大动物园。在晚宴上，特朗普揭幕了一座相当大的白头海雕雕像，作为送给这位中国专制统治者的礼物。 “We hope it’ll find a nice place, a wonderful place, in Beijing,” Mr. Trump said. “我们希望它能在北京找到一个好地方，一个绝好的位置，”特朗普说。 Sadly for Mr. Trump, almost none of this made it onto the television networks he watches so closely. The Chinese state visit has collided with the consequences of the decision he made in a fit of pique last Friday to ban CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House campus. A judge ordered the Trump administration to let the banned reporters back Thursday, but the TV networks are still refusing to take Mr. Trump’s carnival live. title: “习特会”落幕，中美分歧仍然暗流涌动
description: ZOLAN KANNO-YOUNGS, DAVID E. SANGER2026年9月26日 The state visit by President Xi Jinping of China was full of lavish gestures and polite words, but there were few tangible policy announcements on some of the most pressing issues of modern times, such as artificial intelligence, the future of Taiwan and the war in Iran. 中国国家主席习近平的此次国事访问不乏隆重的礼遇与客套的言辞，但在当今时代一些最为紧迫的议题上——如人工智能、台湾前景以及伊朗战争——却鲜有实质性的政策宣布。 At least in public, President Trump seemed more focused on playing host than challenging his geopolitical rival. 至少在公开场合，特朗普总统似乎更专注于履行东道主之谊，而非向其地缘政治对手发起挑战。 Over tea at the White House with Mr. Xi, Mr. Trump described the summit as “tremendous” and said the two superpowers had made “great strides.” Mr. Xi said he and Mr. Trump had added “new substance” to the relationship. 在白宫与习近平茶叙时，特朗普称此次峰会“非常成功”，并表示这两个超级大国已取得“巨大跨越”。习近平则表示，他与特朗普“丰富了”两国关系的“内涵”。 But after nearly two days of meetings, the leaders of the world’s two largest economies and artificial intelligence superpowers had little to show beyond the pageantry. 然而，除了盛大的排场之外，在历时近两天的会谈之后，这两位全球最大经济体兼人工智能超级大国的领导人几乎未能拿出任何实质成果。 Gone were the days when Mr. Trump used meetings with the Chinese leader to celebrate big business deals, like purchases of soybeans and Boeings. Instead, he stressed how well he and Mr. Xi get along, as if that were a shield to questions about Chinese companies aiding Iran with satellite imagery that it has used to mount attacks in the region, or the rapid growth of its nuclear weapons program or its territorial declarations in the South China Sea. 特朗普过去利用与中国领导人的会晤来庆祝大额商业订单（如采购大豆和波音飞机）的日子已一去不复返。取而代之的是，他极力强调自己与习近平相处融洽，仿佛这能成为挡箭牌，规避外界对中国企业向伊朗提供卫星图像协助其在该地区发动袭击、中国核武器计划迅猛扩张以及中国在南海的领土主张等问题的质疑。 “Trump has increasingly collapsed the vast challenge of U.S.-China relations into the narrow question of his personal relationship with Xi,” said Julian Gewirtz, a former China director for the National Security Council in the Biden administration and now a research scholar at Columbia University. “He seems either unaware of or unconcerned by Beijing’s effort to turn today’s stabilization into tomorrow’s constraints on U.S. policy.” “特朗普日益将美中关系的宏大挑战简化为其与习近平个人关系这一狭义问题，”拜登政府时期国家安全委员会前中国事务主任、现哥伦比亚大学研究学者朱利安·格维茨表示。“对于北京试图将眼下的局势稳定转化为未来对美国政策的钳制，他似乎要么浑然不知，要么漠不关心。” 周五，彭丽媛与梅拉尼娅·特朗普在白宫与各自的丈夫习近平和特朗普一同茶叙。 Mr. Trump showed the Chinese leader the construction of the White House helipad and ballroom. He presented Mr. Xi a statue of a bald eagle as American tech titans dined on sea bass. And even as the White House runs a taxpayer-funded advertisement condemning communism, Mr. Trump took the leader of China on a tour of the National Archives to see the founding documents of American democracy. 特朗普陪同中国领导人参观了白宫直升机停机坪和宴会厅的施工现场。在美国科技巨头品尝海鲈鱼之际，他向习近平赠送了一尊白头鹰雕像。甚至在白宫投放由纳税人资助的广告谴责共产主义的同时，特朗普还陪同中国领导人参观了国家档案馆，观看了美国民主的立国文献。 In many ways, the summit between Mr. Trump and Mr. Xi was more notable for what they appeared to avoid detailing rather than what they did announce. 在很大程度上，特朗普与习近平之间的这场峰会值得关注之处更多在于双方似乎刻意回避详述的内容，而非他们实际公布的成果。 Of course, the administration could announce some progress in the days ahead. When asked if the visit had produced additional policy plans, the White House referred to one of Mr. Trump’s social media posts describing the visit as “one of Friendship, Strength, and Success.” “Much has been, and will be, accomplished,” Mr. Trump said without providing details. 当然，美国政府可能会在未来几天公布一些进展。当被问及此次访问是否产生了更多政策成果时，白宫建议媒体参考特朗普发表的一条社交媒体动态。在该贴文中，特朗普将这次访问描述为“展现友谊、实力与成功之旅”。“许多工作已经完成，更多成果在后头，”特朗普在未提供具体细节的情况下如是说道。 Mr. Trump’s aides and supporters say his personal relationship is key to his diplomatic approach with China. 特朗普的幕僚与支持者指出，私交是他开展对华外交策略的核心关键。 The two nations did agree to extend, briefly, a trade truce reached in October 2025 during a meeting in South Korea. That deal had eased an intensifying economic confrontation, during which Mr. Trump imposed tariffs that briefly reached 145 percent, and Mr. Xi suspended most exports of critical minerals and magnets. 双方确实同意短暂延长2025年10月在韩国会晤期间达成的贸易休战协议。该协议曾在一定程度上缓解了不断升温的经济对抗；在对抗期间，特朗普一度加征高达145%的关税，而习近平则暂停了绝大多数关键矿物与磁体的出口。 The accord, set to expire in November, was extended by two months. Mr. Trump said his efforts with Mr. Xi would also be “great for the farmers” but neither side gave any details. China had agreed to sharply increase its purchases of American agricultural products when the two leaders last met, but there is little sign Beijing has made good on the promise. 这项原定于11月到期的协议获展期两个月。特朗普声称他与习近平的沟通也将“对广大农民大有裨益”，但双方均未透露任何细节。两国领导人上次会晤时，中国曾同意大幅增加对美农产品的采购，但几乎没有迹象表明北京兑现了承诺。 特朗普陪同一名共产主义政权领导人参观美国国家档案馆，并观看了《独立宣言》。 There were no new announcements on how to rein in artificial intelligence, even after a summer in which A.I. agents broke out of the “sandboxes” where they were being tested, conducted cyberattacks on their own and covered their tracks. Mr. Trump had short-circuited the discussion using social media to declare that A.I. “will be a big topic of discussion, but I want to leave it exactly where it is,” posting hours before Mr. Xi arrived. “That is China’s position also.” 尽管在此前的夏季中，AI智能体曾突破测试“沙盒”并自主发起网络攻击且掩盖踪迹，但本次会晤并未就如何约束人工智能出台新举措。早在习近平抵达前数小时，特朗普便通过社交平台发文打断了该议题的讨论，声称人工智能“固然是重要议题，但我希望维持现状”，并补充称“这也是中国的立场”。 But the Chinese leader, in his opening statement, emphasized the need for “human control” over A.I. agents, a topic Mr. Trump has avoided. It is still unclear whether they discussed the subject at any length in private. 然而中国领导人在开场致辞中，强调了对AI智能体保持“人类控制”的必要性，而这一话题正是特朗普所刻意回避的。双方是否在闭门会谈中深入探讨了该议题，目前仍不得而知。 Much the same mystery surrounds their talks on Taiwan. Mr. Trump told reporters on the way back from his trip to China in May that he would soon decide on a new arms package for Taiwan, after consulting Taiwan’s “leader,” presumably a reference to President Lai Ching-te. Such a consultation would have been a breach of the rules in how to deal with the island territory, which China claims as its own, and there is no evidence that it happened. Mr. Trump never made public a decision. 双方关于台湾问题的会谈同样笼罩在迷雾之中。特朗普在5月访华归程中曾向媒体表示，他在咨询台湾“领导人”（推测指赖清德）后，将很快就对台新军售案作出决定。此种协商本会违背处理该岛屿领土（中国声明拥有其主权）的交往惯例，且并无证据表明此类协商确实发生过。特朗普也始终未公开任何决定。 Mr. Xi pressed Mr. Trump to oppose Taiwan independence, according to a Chinese readout of their meetings. (To shape the narrative, China turned out its version of the discussions almost immediately.) 根据中方发布的会谈通稿，习近平敦促特朗普明确反对“台独”。（为了引导舆论叙事，中方几乎在会后第一时间发布了其版本的会谈情况。） 特朗普向习近平展示他在白宫新建的直升机停机坪。 Mr. Trump appears to have not given him any commitments. David Purdue, the U.S. ambassador to China, told CNBC there had been no change in the administration’s approach to Taiwan. 特朗普似乎并未做出任何承诺。美国驻华大使庞德伟(David Purdue)向CNBC表示，本届政府在台湾问题上的既定政策并未发生改变。 Allen R. Carlson, a professor at Cornell University who focuses on U.S.-China relations and Asia security, said Mr. Trump’s apparent refusal to acquiesce to Mr. Xi’s demands on Taiwan could be viewed as “good news for America’s standing and for the island.” 康奈尔大学关注美中关系与亚洲安全的教授艾伦·R·卡尔森指出，特朗普显然拒绝默许习近平在台湾问题上的诉求，这可被视为“对美国的国际威望以及台湾方面的利好消息”。 But he said it is also a sign of the low expectations for the summit. 但他也表示，这同样折射出外界对此次峰会的期望值普遍偏低。 “We are now relieved when an American president simply declines to narrow a commitment that has stood for forty years,” Mr. Carlson said. “His silence will be counted in some corners as an American win. In reality the game and set go to Beijing, if not yet the match.” “如今只要美国总统没有削弱一项延续了四十年的承诺，我们竟就会感到如释重负，”卡尔森表示。“他的沉默在某些阵营看来将被奉为美国的胜利。但现实是，即便尚未输掉整场比赛，这一局和这一盘的赢家也是北京。” Mr. Xi came armed with the ultimate soft-power diplomatic gesture. He announced a decision to send two pandas to the Atlanta zoo and committed to accepting tens of thousands of additional American exchange students in China in the coming years. But that was reaching into an old playbook for Chinese leaders. 习近平此次展现了极具代表性的软实力外交姿态。他宣布将向亚特兰大动物园运送两只大熊猫，并承诺在未来几年内额外接收上万名美国交换生赴华学习。然而，这不过是沿用了中国领导人的传统策略。 The two are expected to meet again this year. Mr. Trump told Mr. Xi that he would be attending the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen, China, in November. He later added that Mr. Xi agreed to attend the Group of 20 summit in Florida in December. “I look forward to our next meeting!” Mr. Trump said on social media. 预计双方年内还将再次会晤。特朗普向习近平表示，他将出席11月在中国深圳举行的亚太经合组织(APEC)峰会。他随后补充称，习近平已同意出席12月在佛罗里达州举行的二十国集团峰会。“期待我们的下一次聚会！”特朗普在社交平台上写道。 Mr. Trump insisted on social media that the meetings with Mr. Xi were “very productive.” 特朗普在社交媒体上强调，与习近平的会晤“富有建设性”。 The one example he cited in that post was Mr. Xi’s seemingly supporting his rebrand of artificial intelligence as “super intelligence.” 他在该帖文中举出的唯一例证，是习近平似乎赞同他将人工智能改称为“超级智能”(super intelligence)。 “That would be ‘SUPER!’” Mr. Trump said. “那真是‘超’棒！”特朗普写道。 Zolan Kanno-Young是时报白宫记者，报道特朗普总统及其政府。 David E. Sanger报道特朗普政府和一系列国家安全问题。他在时报任职超过40年，著有四本关于美国国家安全挑战的书。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。
content: ZOLAN KANNO-YOUNGS, DAVID E. SANGER 2026年9月26日 The state visit by President Xi Jinping of China was full of lavish gestures and polite words, but there were few tangible policy announcements on some of the most pressing issues of modern times, such as artificial intelligence, the future of Taiwan and the war in Iran. 中国国家主席习近平的此次国事访问不乏隆重的礼遇与客套的言辞，但在当今时代一些最为紧迫的议题上——如人工智能、台湾前景以及伊朗战争——却鲜有实质性的政策宣布。 At least in public, President Trump seemed more focused on playing host than challenging his geopolitical rival. 至少在公开场合，特朗普总统似乎更专注于履行东道主之谊，而非向其地缘政治对手发起挑战。 Over tea at the White House with Mr. Xi, Mr. Trump described the summit as “tremendous” and said the two superpowers had made “great strides.” Mr. Xi said he and Mr. Trump had added “new substance” to the relationship. 在白宫与习近平茶叙时，特朗普称此次峰会“非常成功”，并表示这两个超级大国已取得“巨大跨越”。习近平则表示，他与特朗普“丰富了”两国关系的“内涵”。 But after nearly two days of meetings, the leaders of the world’s two largest economies and artificial intelligence superpowers had little to show beyond the pageantry. 然而，除了盛大的排场之外，在历时近两天的会谈之后，这两位全球最大经济体兼人工智能超级大国的领导人几乎未能拿出任何实质成果。 Gone were the days when Mr. Trump used meetings with the Chinese leader to celebrate big business deals, like purchases of soybeans and Boeings. Instead, he stressed how well he and Mr. Xi get along, as if that were a shield to questions about Chinese companies aiding Iran with satellite imagery that it has used to mount attacks in the region, or the rapid growth of its nuclear weapons program or its territorial declarations in the South China Sea. 特朗普过去利用与中国领导人的会晤来庆祝大额商业订单（如采购大豆和波音飞机）的日子已一去不复返。取而代之的是，他极力强调自己与习近平相处融洽，仿佛这能成为挡箭牌，规避外界对中国企业向伊朗提供卫星图像协助其在该地区发动袭击、中国核武器计划迅猛扩张以及中国在南海的领土主张等问题的质疑。 “Trump has increasingly collapsed the vast challenge of U.S.-China relations into the narrow question of his personal relationship with Xi,” said Julian Gewirtz, a former China director for the National Security Council in the Biden administration and now a research scholar at Columbia University. “He seems either unaware of or unconcerned by Beijing’s effort to turn today’s stabilization into tomorrow’s constraints on U.S. policy.” “特朗普日益将美中关系的宏大挑战简化为其与习近平个人关系这一狭义问题，”拜登政府时期国家安全委员会前中国事务主任、现哥伦比亚大学研究学者朱利安·格维茨表示。“对于北京试图将眼下的局势稳定转化为未来对美国政策的钳制，他似乎要么浑然不知，要么漠不关心。” 周五，彭丽媛与梅拉尼娅·特朗普在白宫与各自的丈夫习近平和特朗普一同茶叙。 Mr. Trump showed the Chinese leader the construction of the White House helipad and ballroom. He presented Mr. Xi a statue of a bald eagle as American tech titans dined on sea bass . And even as the White House runs a taxpayer-funded advertisement condemning communism, Mr. Trump took the leader of China on a tour of the National Archives to see the founding documents of American democracy. 特朗普陪同中国领导人参观了白宫直升机停机坪和宴会厅的施工现场。在 美国科技巨头品尝海鲈鱼 之际，他向习近平赠送了一尊白头鹰雕像。甚至在白宫 投放由纳税人资助的广告 谴责共产主义的同时，特朗普还陪同中国领导人参观了国家档案馆，观看了美国民主的立国文献。 In many ways, the summit between Mr. Trump and Mr. Xi was more notable for what they appeared to avoid detailing rather than what they did announce. 在很大程度上，特朗普与习近平之间的这场峰会值得关注之处更多在于双方似乎刻意回避详述的内容，而非他们实际公布的成果。 Of course, the administration could announce some progress in the days ahead. When asked if the visit had produced additional policy plans, the White House referred to one of Mr. Trump’s social media posts describing the visit as “one of Friendship, Strength, and Success.” “Much has been, and will be, accomplished,” Mr. Trump said without providing details. 当然，美国政府可能会在未来几天公布一些进展。当被问及此次访问是否产生了更多政策成果时，白宫建议媒体参考特朗普发表的一条社交媒体动态。在该贴文中，特朗普将这次访问描述为“展现友谊、实力与成功之旅”。“许多工作已经完成，更多成果在后头，”特朗普在未提供具体细节的情况下如是说道。 Mr. Trump’s aides and supporters say his personal relationship is key to his diplomatic approach with China. 特朗普的幕僚与支持者指出，私交是他开展对华外交策略的核心关键。 The two nations did agree to extend, briefly, a trade truce reached in October 2025 during a meeting in South Korea. Mr. Trump had short-circuited the discussion using social media to declare that A.I. “will be a big topic of discussion, but I want to leave it exactly where it is,” posting hours before Mr. Xi arrived. “That is China’s position also.” 尽管在此前的夏季中，AI智能体曾突破测试“沙盒”并自主发起网络攻击且掩盖踪迹，但本次会晤并未就如何约束人工智能出台新举措。早在习近平抵达前数小时，特朗普便通过社交平台发文打断了该议题的讨论，声称人工智能“固然是重要议题，但我希望维持现状”，并补充称“这也是中国的立场”。 But the Chinese leader, in his opening statement, emphasized the need for “human control” over A.I. agents, a topic Mr. Trump has avoided. It is still unclear whether they discussed the subject at any length in private. 然而中国领导人在开场致辞中，强调了对AI智能体保持“人类控制”的必要性，而这一话题正是特朗普所刻意回避的。双方是否在闭门会谈中深入探讨了该议题，目前仍不得而知。 Much the same mystery surrounds their talks on Taiwan. Mr. Trump told reporters on the way back from his trip to China in May that he would soon decide on a new arms package for Taiwan, after consulting Taiwan’s “leader,” presumably a reference to President Lai Ching-te. Such a consultation would have been a breach of the rules in how to deal with the island territory, which China claims as its own, and there is no evidence that it happened. Mr. Trump never made public a decision. 双方关于台湾问题的会谈同样笼罩在迷雾之中。特朗普在5月访华归程中曾向媒体表示，他在咨询台湾“领导人”（推测指赖清德）后，将很快就对台新军售案作出决定。此种协商本会违背处理该岛屿领土（中国声明拥有其主权）的交往惯例，且并无证据表明此类协商确实发生过。特朗普也始终未公开任何决定。 Mr. Xi pressed Mr. Trump to oppose Taiwan independence, according to a Chinese readout of their meetings. (To shape the narrative, China turned out its version of the discussions almost immediately.) 根据中方发布的会谈通稿，习近平敦促特朗普明确反对“台独”。（为了引导舆论叙事，中方几乎在会后第一时间发布了其版本的会谈情况。） 特朗普向习近平展示他在白宫新建的直升机停机坪。 Mr. Trump appears to have not given him any commitments. title: 中美贸易休战延长为习近平赢得喘息之机
description: KEITH BRADSHER2026年9月26日特朗普总统周四与中国领导人习近平举行会晤。中美贸易摩擦一度似乎对中国构成重大威胁，如今已有所缓和。 Doug Mills/The New York Times For China and its top leader, Xi Jinping, the biggest prize from a summit in Washington, notably free from confrontation, may be simple: time. 对于中国及其最高领导人习近平而言，这场在华盛顿举行、显著缺乏对抗色彩的峰会带来的最大收获或许很简单：时间。 Time to cope with a housing market crash that has wiped away the savings of tens of millions of Chinese families. Time to deal with local governments running short of money as land-use revenue collapses. Time to make China even less vulnerable to economic pressure from the United States and other industrialized countries. 这是一段应对房市崩盘的时间，这场危局已蒸发了数以千万计中国家庭的积蓄；这是一段理顺地方财政的时间，随着土地出让收入锐减，地方政府普遍面临资金匮乏；这也是一段让中国进一步提升抗压能力的时间，使其面对美国及其他工业化国家的经济施压时不再脆弱。 And perhaps most consequentially, time to prepare for the once-in-five-years Communist Party national congress next autumn, which will choose a new slate of top leaders to work under Mr. Xi. 而最具深远意义的是为明年秋季召开的五年一度的中共全国代表大会做准备。届时大会将产生新一届高层领导集团，在习近平的领导下开展工作。 “By trying to stabilize relations with the U.S., China can better concentrate on its own priorities,” said Wu Xinbo, a leading American studies scholar at Fudan University in Shanghai. 上海复旦大学知名美国问题学者吴心伯表示：“通过力求稳定对美关系，中国能够将精力更好地集中于国内的核心议题。” When President Trump returned to office last year, Beijing had little reason to expect such breathing room. 去年特朗普刚刚重返白宫的时候，北京恐怕不会奢望能获得如此宝贵的喘息空间。 Mr. Trump had campaigned on imposing very steep tariffs on imports from China as part of an effort to rebuild America’s industrial base. Three months after taking office, he briefly raised tariffs to 145 percent, while his administration imposed stringent new restrictions on technology trade with China. 在竞选期间，特朗普曾誓言对中国进口商品加征极高关税，以期重塑美国的工业基础。就职仅三个月后，他一度将关税增至145%，同时其政府还实施了新一轮严苛的对华技术贸易限制。 But the confrontation did not unfold the way Beijing had initially feared. 然而，这场正面交锋并未向北京最初担忧的方向演变。 China demonstrated that it had economic weapons of its own, most importantly its dominance of rare-earth metals and magnets essential to the production of cars, electronics and weapons. 中国展现出了自身掌握的经济反制手段，其中最为关键的是其对汽车、电子产品及武器制造不可或缺的稀土金属与磁体的主导地位。 After Beijing restricted rare-earth exports to the United States, Washington backed away from some of its most aggressive measures. Tariffs fell from their peaks, some export controls were eased, and the two governments began negotiating a series of temporary truces. 在北京收紧对美稀土出口后，华盛顿撤回了部分最为激进的举措。关税自高位回落，部分出口管制得到松绑，两国政府开始就一系列临时休战展开谈判。 Economic brinkmanship continues between the two countries, especially in emerging industries such as artificial intelligence and robotics. But the Trump administration has shifted from the extraordinary escalation of its first months to a less confrontational relationship in which China has shown that it, too, can inflict considerable pain on the American economy. 两国间的经济边缘博弈仍在延续，特别是在人工智能与机器人等新兴产业领域。不过，特朗普政府已从执政初期不同寻常的局势升级策略转向了一种对抗性较低的相处模式；在这种模式下，中国同样证明了自身具备给美国经济造成重创的能力。 Many China experts in the United States now see the Trump administration as pursuing a less combative policy toward Beijing than the posture favored by many Democratic and Republican leaders. 如今，许多美国国内的中国问题专家认为，特朗普政府对北京采取的政策比许多民主党和共和党领袖所主张的立场更具妥协色彩。 “I see the current policy as far too weak and contrary to the views of senior leaders in both parties,” said R. Nicholas Burns, who served as ambassador to China under President Joseph R. Biden Jr. and previously held senior posts elsewhere under President George W. Bush. 曾在小约瑟夫·R·拜登政府担任驻华大使、并在小布什政府中身兼要职的R·尼古拉斯·伯恩斯指出：“在我看来，当前的政策显得过于软弱，且与两党资深领导人的共识背道而驰。” Trade frictions with the United States have consequently receded as an immediate concern in China after seeming to pose a severe threat early in Mr. Trump’s second term. Beijing, however, has not slowed in its longstanding push to become less dependent on the rest of the world for technology or energy. 因此，在特朗普第二任期初期，中美贸易摩擦一度对中国构成严重威胁，但如今已不再是北京亟待解决的燃眉之急。然而，北京并未放慢技术与能源对外依赖度这一既定战略的步伐。 “They want time and stability because it helps them build a more resilient, more self-reliant economy,” said Evan Medeiros, a professor at Georgetown University and a former senior Asia director on the National Security Council under President Barack Obama. “It gives them time to reduce their exposure to the U.S.” 乔治城大学教授、奥巴马政府国家安全委员会前亚洲事务高级主任麦艾文(Evan Medeiros)分析道：“他们渴望赢得时间和稳定，因为这有助于他们打造一个更有韧性、更自给自足的经济体系。这为他们减少对美风险敞口争取了时间。” For two decades, Beijing has pursued a consistent policy of replacing high-tech imports with domestic production. That push has helped China become a dominant producer of everything from batteries and solar panels to telecommunications equipment and electric vehicles. It has also made China less vulnerable to foreign economic pressure while leaving other industrialized countries increasingly dependent on Chinese supplies of key raw materials or manufactured goods. 二十年来，北京始终贯彻以本土生产替代高科技进口的坚定政策。这一政策的推行助力中国成为了从电池、太阳能电池板到电信设备、电动汽车等众多领域的主导生产国。这不仅降低了中国面对外部经济施压时的脆弱性，也让其他工业化国家日益依赖中国关键原材料与工业品的供给。 Beijing has pursued a similar strategy of energy self-reliance. Its enormous investments in electric vehicles, wind and solar power, as well as its national electricity grid, have reduced its dependence on imported fossil fuels, helping insulate the economy from high oil prices and supply shortages caused by the war in Iran. 在能源自给自足方面，北京同样采取了类似的战略。其在电动汽车、风电与光伏以及国家电网构建上的巨额投入，降低了对进口化石燃料的依赖，帮助本国经济躲过了因伊朗战争引起的高油价与能源短缺冲击。 China is also using the lull in trade tensions productively. 中国亦在高效利用贸易局势缓和带来的喘息之机。 Its overall trade surplus has surged since Mr. Trump returned to office and is on course to match or surpass last year’s record of roughly $1.2 trillion. Chinese exporters have expanded rapidly into Southeast Asia, Latin America and other markets, reducing their direct dependence on the United States even as many goods reach American consumers through third countries. 自特朗普重返白宫以来，中国的整体贸易顺差大幅攀升，有望追平甚至突破去年约1.2万亿美元的历史纪录。中国出口商迅速开辟东南亚、拉丁美洲等新市场，降低了对美国的直接依赖；与此同时，大量商品正通过第三方国家间接输往美国消费者手中。 Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said at the start of the summit that China and the United States had agreed to extend their trade truce until Jan. 10. China’s Ministry of Commerce confirmed an extension, without specifying a duration. 财政部长斯科特·贝森特在峰会开幕时透露，美中双方已同意将贸易休战期延长至明年1月10日。中国商务部随后确认了延长休战的决定，但未指明具体截止日期。 The relatively short extension could reflect a calculation in Beijing that its bargaining position may improve with time, especially if the Republican Party loses badly in the midterm elections. 这一相对短期的休战延长，或许反映出北京方面的策略盘算：随着时间的推移，其谈判筹码可能会进一步增强，特别是在共和党若在中期选举中遭遇重挫的情况下。 “Suddenly, the negotiation price changes because Trump will be on his back foot, he’ll be weak against China, and he’ll need China even more than he does today,” Mr. Medeiros said. 麦艾文指出：“届时谈判的门槛将发生改变，因为特朗普将陷入被动，在对华交锋中处于弱势，对中国的需求也会比现在更加迫切。” For U.S. negotiators, the extension allows them to continue seeking a deal as soon as possible after the midterm elections. 对美国谈判代表而言，休战延期使他们能够在中期选举结束后继续争取尽快达成全面协议。 The summit has also given Mr. Xi a chance to portray himself at home as a powerful and respected world leader. Mr. Trump welcomed Mr. Xi as he disembarked from his plane, whereas Mr. Xi sent Vice President Han Zheng to the airport to welcome Mr. Trump to Beijing in May. 这场峰会也让习近平可以趁机在国内塑造自己强大且受尊重的全球领袖形象。在此次峰会中，特朗普亲自前往舷梯前迎接下飞机的习近平；而在今年5月特朗普访华时，习近平是派副主席韩正前往接机。 A display of Mr. Xi’s stature — and, by extension, China’s — is particularly useful as Beijing seeks a tranquil international environment ahead of next year’s Communist Party congress. Mr. Xi appears highly likely to remain in charge even as leaders around him may change. But the gathering will still require extensive maneuvering over senior appointments and policy priorities. 在北京力求在明年中共全国代表大会前营造平稳外部环境之际，展现习近平以及中国的国际影响力尤为重要。尽管他身边的高层人事可能迎来调整，但习近平继续执政几乎已成定局。即便如此，这场盛会仍需要围绕高层人事布局与政策优先事项展开密集的内部协调。 Repeated meetings with Mr. Trump could help keep China’s most important foreign relationship stable as Mr. Xi turns his attention to domestic politics. 在习近平将精力转回国内政治之际，与特朗普保持频密会晤有助于夯实中国最重要的一对双边关系。 And few domestic problems are more pressing than the country’s housing market crash. 而在当前，没有哪一项国内难题比房地产市场的全面崩盘更为紧迫。 The property downturn has created a cascade of problems. Falling apartment prices have eaten into household savings, while the collapse in property development has gutted the land-use revenue many local governments depended on. Apartment prices have already fallen twice as far as they did in the United States during the American housing market debacle nearly two decades ago. 楼市持续低迷引发了一连串连锁反应。房价下挫侵蚀了居民家庭的积蓄，房企倒闭潮则抽干了许多地方政府赖以维系财政的土地出让收入。当下的住宅价格跌幅已达近二十年前美国次贷危机时期房价跌幅的两倍。 Chinese families have responded by cutting back sharply on spending. Restaurants, shopping malls and car dealerships are struggling, while weak domestic demand has left China increasingly reliant on its export industries to sustain growth. 中国家庭对此做出的直接反应是急剧紧缩开支。餐饮、商场以及汽车销售行业陷入苦撑，疲软的内需迫使中国经济更加依赖出口产业来维持增长底线。 Mr. Trump returned to office threatening tariffs severe enough to reshape China’s export economy. Nearly halfway through the American president’s second term, those tariffs are modest, China’s trade surplus shows no signs of slowing, and Beijing has demonstrated considerable economic leverage. 特朗普重返白宫时曾威胁要加征足以重塑中国出口经济的严厉关税。然而，在其第二任期即将过半之际，这些关税措施显得相对温和，中国的贸易顺差扩大势头丝毫没有放缓的迹象，反而展示出了相当可观的经济制衡杠杆。 For Mr. Xi, then, another summit that ends without the steep American tariffs once threatened against Chinese exports may represent the biggest victory of all. 因此，对于习近平而言，又一场没有以美国加征高昂关税收场的峰会——这样的关税一度威胁到中国的出口——或许本身就是一种至关重要的胜利。 David Pierson自香港对本文有报道贡献。 Keith Bradsher是《纽约时报》北京分社社长，此前曾任上海分社社长、香港分社社长、底特律分社社长，以及华盛顿记者。他在新冠疫情期间常驻中国进行报道。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 聚焦中美元首峰会：军机表演和盛大仪式背后的博弈与分歧
description: ZOLAN KANNO-YOUNGS2026年9月25日周四，习近平和彭丽媛在白宫进行国事访问期间与特朗普和梅拉尼娅合影。 Haiyun Jiang/The New York Times President Trump said he had “never gotten along better” with President Xi Jinping of China on Thursday during a day of military flyovers, gifts of pandas and lavish ceremonies that masked significant divides over artificial intelligence and trade.“President Xi and I both understand that we represent different systems but the ties between our people endure,” Mr. Trump said at the start of the state dinner with Mr. Xi at the White House. “Together we can continue to build a relationship that promotes prosperity and security for future generations.” 周四，特朗普总统表示，他与中国国家主席习近平“关系从未如此融洽”。这一天充满了军机飞行表演、赠送大熊猫和盛大仪式，掩盖了双方在人工智能和贸易方面的重大分歧。“习近平主席和我都明白，我们代表着不同的制度，但我们两国人民之间的纽带历久弥坚，”特朗普在白宫与习近平的国宴开始时说。“我们可以共同继续建立一种关系，促进子孙后代的繁荣与安全。” The flattery capped a day in which Mr. Trump appeared focused on growing a personal relationship with Mr. Xi to strengthen ties between the two nations, while Mr. Xi at times was more pointed on the challenges before them. 这番恭维为当天画上了句号。在这一天里，特朗普似乎专注于发展与习近平的个人关系，以加强两国之间的联系，而习近平则有时更为直截了当地指出双方面临的挑战。 After arriving to the White House earlier in the day, Mr. Xi warned that the two countries should avoid the “Thucydides Trap,” the theory that a rising power and an established power are likely to go to war.“We do not need to avoid mentioning competition, but our competition should be a healthy one and should be kept within bounds,” Mr. Xi said. “It should be a race of catching up with one another, not a wrestle in which one either wins or loses. China and the United States must hold the line of no conflict and no confrontation between us." 在当天早些时候抵达白宫后，习近平警告说，两国应避免“修昔底德陷阱”——这一理论认为，新兴大国和老牌强国之间很可能会走向战争。“中美不必讳言竞争，但竞争应该是良性的，有边界的，”习近平说。“应该是你追我赶的赛跑，而不是你输我赢的角斗。中美双方必须守住不冲突、不对抗的底线。” The two leaders did appear to broach pressing issues behind the scenes. Mr. Trump said they planned on discussing security and “super intelligence,” his attempt at rebranding artificial intelligence, technology that has spurred global concern in recent weeks. In their private meeting, the two leaders also deliberated trade, Taiwan, the Middle East and Russia’s war in Ukraine, according to the official Chinese summary of talks. 两位领导人似乎确实在幕后探讨了紧迫问题。特朗普表示，他们计划讨论安全和“超级智能” (super intelligence)——这是他为人工智能重新命名的尝试，这项技术在最近几周引发了全球担忧。根据中方关于会谈的官方摘要，在闭门会议中，两位领导人还商讨了贸易、台湾、中东以及俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争等问题。 On Wednesday, the two nations agreed to extend a shaky trade truce — that eased an intensifying trade war — by two months past a November deadline. But there was little sign of other policies that came about from the pomp and circumstance. 周三，两国同意将一项摇摇欲坠的贸易休战协议在11月的截止日期之后再延长两个月，该休战曾缓解了两国日益加剧的贸易战。但在这场盛大的仪式中，几乎看不到取得其他政策成果的迹象。 Mr. Xi, in public at least, went further than Mr. Trump on the issue of artificial intelligence. During his opening remarks at the White House, Mr. Xi said he wanted to ensure A.I. was “always under human control.” Mr. Trump has called fears about A.I. leading to mass extinction a “hoax.” 至少在公开场合，习近平在人工智能问题上的表态比特朗普走得更远。在白宫的开场致辞中，习近平表示希望确保人工智能“始终受控于人”。而特朗普则将对人工智能导致大规模灭绝的担忧称为“骗局”。 特朗普以自己的个人外交风格为傲，尽管中美之间存在竞争，但他仍对习近平给予了热情接待。 Mr. Trump, who prides himself on his personal brand of diplomacy, has extended his hand to Mr. Xi, despite the rivalry between the United States and China. Mr. Trump accused China this summer of “sinister election meddling” in the 2020 election. And Beijing has shown no signs of retreating from its business dealings with Tehran since the U.S. and Israeli war against Iran began this year.Since the start of the war, Chinese companies have even provided Tehran with satellite imagery, and access to a spy satellite, that Iran’s military forces have used to mount attacks in the region, according to multiple U.S. officials. 特朗普以自己的个人外交风格为傲，尽管中美之间存在竞争，他仍向习近平示好。今年夏天，特朗普曾指责中国在2020年大选中进行了“阴险的选举干预”。此外，自今年美以对伊朗发动战争以来，北京没有表现出任何迹象，要从与德黑兰的商业往来中退出。多位美国官员表示，自战争爆发以来，中国公司甚至向德黑兰提供了卫星图像和一颗间谍卫星的访问权限，伊朗军队利用该卫星在该地区发动了袭击。 There is little sign that China had made good on a promise made during Mr. Trump’s visit with Mr. Xi in Beijing earlier this year to sharply increase its purchases of American agriculture products. 几乎没有迹象表明中国兑现了今年早些时候特朗普在北京与习近平会面时做出的大幅增加购买美国农产品的承诺。 But Mr. Trump, who once criticized the Obama administration for hosting Mr. Xi, appeared particularly focused on playing the part of host rather than rival. 特朗普曾对奥巴马政府接待习近平做出批评，但此次他似乎格外专注于扮演东道主而非竞争对手的角色。 “In return for China breaking nearly every trade promise it has made, Trump is rolling out the red carpet for President Xi,” said Senator Ron Wyden, Democrat of Oregon. “There is no evidence that Trump is using this opportunity to push back on the Chinese government policies that hurt our workers and businesses, from forced labor to state subsidies. Donald Trump is giving away the store to China and leaving American families with the bill.” “中国几乎违背了它做出的所有贸易承诺，作为回报，特朗普却为习近平主席铺上了红毯，”俄勒冈州民主党参议员罗恩·怀登表示。“没有证据表明特朗普正在利用这个机会反击从强迫劳动到国家补贴这些损害我们工人和企业利益的中国政府政策。唐纳德·特朗普正在向中国大肆让步，却让美国家庭来买单。” On Wednesday, Mr. Trump went to Joint Base Andrews to greet Mr. Xi, breaking from the usual tradition of greeting world leaders at the White House. He presented him with an honor guard ceremony in the Rose Garden featuring a military flyover of a B2 bomber and F-22 jets. He then gave Mr. Xi a tour of his new helipad on the White House grounds. 周三，特朗普打破了总统通常在白宫迎接世界领导人的传统，前往安德鲁斯联合基地迎接习近平。他在玫瑰园为习近平举行了仪仗队欢迎仪式，其中包括B-2轰炸机和F-22战机的军机飞行表演。随后，他带习近平参观了白宫内新建的直升机停机坪。 Mr. Trump later hosted Mr. Xi for a state dinner in the East Room with Chinese officials, G.O.P. donors and a number of high-profile executives, including Jeff Bezos, Jensen Huang and Elon Musk. Rather than speak about artificial intelligence, Mr. Trump appeared to break from his scripted remarks to direct Mr. Xi to one of the points of pride of his second term. 之后，特朗普在东厅为习近平举行了国宴，中国官员、共和党捐助者以及杰夫·贝佐斯、黄仁勋和埃隆·马斯克等众多知名高管出席了晚宴。特朗普并未谈及人工智能，他似乎偏离了预先准备的讲稿，向习近平重点介绍了其第二任期内一个引以为豪的成就。 “It’s one year away from complete, the new ballroom that you’ve heard about,” Mr. Trump said. “And you will see something that I think you will really love.” “你听说过的那个新宴会厅，距离完工还有一年，”特朗普说。“到时候你会看到一些我认为你肯定非常喜欢的东西。” Mr. Xi came with gifts. He announced China would be sending two pandas to the Atlanta zoo. 习近平带来了礼物。他宣布中国将向亚特兰大动物园赠送两只大熊猫。 周三，特朗普前往安德鲁斯联合基地迎接习近平，这打破了总统通常在白宫迎接世界各国领导人的惯例。 In a Truth Social post, Mr. Trump said the day was a made-for-TV moment. But it was missing a crucial component. Major television networks declined to provide shared footage of the events after Mr. Trump blocked CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House. 在Truth Social的一篇帖文中，特朗普称这一天堪称为电视量身定做的时刻。但却缺少了一个关键要素。在特朗普禁止CNN、MS NOW和Politico进入白宫后，各大电视网拒绝提供这些活动的共享画面。 Reporters from those outlets had their access restored around midday, but the TV pool remained suspended. The networks had indicated that they would not resume coverage following the president until the White House had formally agreed to allow CNN to participate once again in the pool. 这些媒体的记者在中午前后恢复了入场权限，但电视联合采访团仍处于停摆状态。各大电视网曾表示，除非白宫正式同意让CNN再次参与电视联合采访团，否则不会恢复对总统的跟拍报道。 A crowd of Chinese state media workers were, however, allowed onto the White House grounds. 然而，一群中国官方媒体工作人员却被允许进入白宫。 After Mr. Trump’s toast at the state dinner, Mr. Xi selectively recited the history of the two countries, choosing to ignore the worst moments of the Cold War but rather invoke President Richard Nixon’s rapprochement with Beijing in 1972. The message to Trump appeared to be that he, too, had an opportunity to re-establish ties with China, though on Beijing’s terms. 在特朗普于国宴上致祝酒辞后，习近平选择性地回顾了两国的历史，他选择忽略冷战最糟糕的时刻，而是提到理查德·尼克松总统在1972年与北京的破冰和解。这向特朗普传递的信息似乎是，他也有机会重新建立与中国的关系，尽管是按照北京的条件。 “Such a friendship, forged in blood and fire,” he said, “will surely live on through the generations.” “这份血与火锻造的友谊，”习近平说，“必将世代相传。” David E. Sanger、Anton Troianovski、David Pierson、Erica L. Green和储百亮(Chris Buckley)对本文有报道贡献。 Zolan Kanno-Youngs是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统及其政府新闻。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

The networks had indicated that they would not resume coverage following the president until the White House had formally agreed to allow CNN to participate once again in the pool. 这些媒体的记者在中午前后恢复了入场权限，但电视联合采访团仍处于停摆状态。各大电视网曾表示，除非白宫正式同意让CNN再次参与电视联合采访团，否则不会恢复对总统的跟拍报道。 A crowd of Chinese state media workers were, however, allowed onto the White House grounds. 然而，一群中国官方媒体工作人员却被允许进入白宫。 After Mr. Trump’s toast at the state dinner, Mr. Xi selectively recited the history of the two countries, choosing to ignore the worst moments of the Cold War but rather invoke President Richard Nixon’s rapprochement with Beijing in 1972. The message to Trump appeared to be that he, too, had an opportunity to re-establish ties with China, though on Beijing’s terms. 在特朗普于国宴上致祝酒辞后，习近平选择性地回顾了两国的历史，他选择忽略冷战最糟糕的时刻，而是提到理查德·尼克松总统在1972年与北京的破冰和解。这向特朗普传递的信息似乎是，他也有机会重新建立与中国的关系，尽管是按照北京的条件。 “Such a friendship, forged in blood and fire,” he said, “will surely live on through the generations.” “这份血与火锻造的友谊，”习近平说，“必将世代相传。” David E. Sanger、Anton Troianovski、David Pierson、Erica L. Green和储百亮(Chris Buckley)对本文有报道贡献。 Zolan Kanno-Youngs 是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统及其政府新闻。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 特朗普的白宫欢迎强人领袖习近平，却拒绝美国记者
description: PETER BAKER2026年9月25日习近平在白宫受到隆重欢迎，但美国的各家电视网却没有报道这一盛况，因为它们仍在抵制白宫记者团。 Haiyun Jiang/The New York Times At the White House gate, a throng of Chinese journalists was being admitted onto the grounds of the Executive Mansion to cover the visit of President Xi Jinping. Out on the street, several American journalists were blocked from entering the White House on the orders of President Trump. 在白宫门口，一群中国记者正获准进入行政官邸，报道习近平主席的访问。而在外面的街道上，数名美国记者却因特朗普总统的命令无法入内。 The scene on Pennsylvania Avenue on Thursday morning captured a surreal week in the life of Washington. The president of the United States barred American reporters because he labeled them a threat to national security, while welcoming Chinese reporters who answer to the communist dictatorship in Beijing. 周四上午宾夕法尼亚大道上的这一幕捕捉到了华盛顿这一周荒诞离奇的政治现实。美国总统将美国记者拒之门外，称他们是国家安全的威胁，同时却欢迎那些听命于北京共产党独裁政权的中国记者。 This would be the same president who is running government-paid television advertising vowing to stop the United States from becoming socialist or communist in the same week that he held a friendly meeting with the democratic socialist mayor of New York and rolled out a literal red carpet for the communist president of China. The same president who is waging economic war against the prime minister of Canada while inviting the president of Russia to visit his Florida golf club. 同样是这位总统，一边用政府经费投放电视广告，信誓旦旦地宣称要阻止美国变成社会主义或共产主义，一边却在同一周与纽约的民主社会主义市长友好会面，还为中国的这位共产党领导人实实在在地铺上了红地毯。同样也是这位总统，一边对加拿大总理发动经济战，一边却邀请俄罗斯总统访问他位于佛罗里达的高尔夫俱乐部。 周四，中国媒体在白宫外。白宫随行记者团的报道称，当天特朗普总统曾“开玩笑说，中国拥有最友好的记者团”。 In the epic contest between democracy and autocracy, Mr. Trump has long given the impression that he may be on the other side. But rarely has that been brought home as starkly as this week, as he punishes news outlets for being too “negative” about him while embracing Mr. Xi and President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia, two of the world’s leading authoritarians whose governments brutally suppress free speech. 在民主与专制这场旷日持久的较量中，特朗普向来给人的印象是，他似乎更倾向于站在专制那一边。但这种印象很少像本周这样赤裸裸地呈现出来：他一边因为新闻机构对自己的报道过于“负面”而惩罚它们，一边却热情拥抱习近平和俄罗斯总统普京——这两位都是世界上主要的威权主义者，其政府残酷压制言论自由。 Mr. Xi’s arrival at the White House was celebrated with pomp and circumstance that were not covered by American television networks, which were still boycotting the White House press pool until Mr. Trump’s staff commits in writing to letting CNN cameras back into the rotation. Reporters from CNN, MS NOW and Politico who were initially barred from entering the White House on Thursday morning despite a court order were allowed in later in the day, but by late afternoon Mr. Trump’s staff had still not permitted CNN back into the pool that provides footage of the president every day. 习近平在白宫受到隆重欢迎，但美国的各家电视网却没有报道这一盛况，因为它们仍在抵制白宫记者团，直到特朗普的工作人员以书面形式承诺让CNN的摄像机重回轮值。周四上午，尽管有法院命令，CNN、MS NOW和Politico的记者起初仍被禁止进入白宫；当天晚些时候，他们获准进入。但截至下午晚些时候，特朗普的工作人员仍未允许CNN重新加入每日拍摄总统日常活动、供各方共享画面的记者团。 Even as Mr. Trump fumed that his carefully orchestrated day of pageantry was not shown on air, he basked in Mr. Xi’s presence and lavished him with praise, making no mention of human rights issues that past presidents raised when meeting with Chinese counterparts. 尽管特朗普对自己精心筹划的这场盛大仪式未能在电视上播出而大为光火，但他仍陶醉于中国领导人的到场，并对其大加赞美，只字未提历任总统在会晤中国领导人时通常都会提及的人权议题。 “From the time of my first election in 2016, President Xi and I have forged a friendship, a truly great friendship, actually, built on mutual respect and the vital interests of our people,” Mr. Trump said in the Grand Foyer of the White House. He later delighted in taking his great friend on a tour of the new White House ballroom that is under construction and showed off his taunting photograph of an autopen meant to represent his predecessor, former President Joseph R. Biden Jr. “自2016年我首次当选以来，我和习主席打造了友谊关系，一段真正伟大的友谊，这段友谊建立在相互尊重和我们的人民的共同利益之上，”特朗普在白宫的主门厅说道。后来，他兴致勃勃地带着这位好友参观正在施工的新白宫宴会厅，还得意地向其展示了一张带有嘲讽意味的照片，照片中是一个自动签名笔，用以影射他的前任拜登总统。 特朗普向习近平展示了一张带有嘲讽意味的照片，照片中是一个自动签名笔，用以影射他的前任拜登总统。 Mr. Trump hopes to similarly host Mr. Putin soon. Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced this week that Mr. Trump had invited the once-ostracized Russian leader to attend the annual Group of 20 meeting in Miami in December, which would be his first appearance at the annual gathering since 2019, before his full-fledged invasion of Ukraine. The summit is scheduled to be held at Trump National Doral Miami, where the president tried to host a Group of 7 meeting in his first term only to back down after Republican complaints that it was too self-dealing — complaints not heard this time. 特朗普希望不久后也能以类似方式接待普京。国务卿鲁比奥本周宣布，特朗普已经邀请这位一度遭到国际社会排斥的俄罗斯领导人出席12月在迈阿密举行的二十国集团年度峰会。如果成行，这将是普京自2019年——即其全面入侵乌克兰之前——以来首次出席这一年度聚会。峰会计划在特朗普国家多拉尔迈阿密度假村举行。特朗普第一个任期内曾试图在那里举办七国集团峰会，却因共和党内部批评此举涉嫌以权谋私而作罢，而这一次，这样的抱怨声却没有出现。 While Mr. Putin was kicked out of the G7 and other groups because of his seizure of Crimea in 2014, Mr. Trump has been eager to bring him back into the international fold. The International Criminal Court issued an arrest warrant for Mr. Putin on war crimes charges in 2023, but Mr. Trump ignored that by inviting the Russian to Alaska last year — and just this week denounced the court in an address to the U.N. General Assembly as “an evil group of people” as his administration attempts to dismantle the body. 普京因为2014年吞并克里米亚而被逐出七国集团及其他国际组织，但特朗普一直热衷于让他重新融入国际社会。国际刑事法院2023年以战争罪指控对普京发出逮捕令，但特朗普对此置之不理，去年还邀请这位俄罗斯领导人前往阿拉斯加。就在本周，他又在联合国大会发表讲话时斥责该法院是“一群邪恶的人”，而他的政府目前正试图搞垮该机构。 Mr. Trump’s affinity for despots, tyrants and autocrats has baffled democratic leaders and diplomats and reoriented American foreign policy for some 10 years now. He gushes over the likes of Kim Jong-un of North Korea (“we fell in love”), Abdel Fattah el-Sisi of Egypt (“my favorite dictator”), Mohammed bin Salman of Saudi Arabia (“I like him too much”), Recep Tayyip Erdogan of Turkey (“a very good friend of mine”) and Nayib Bukele of El Salvador (“one hell of a president”). 特朗普对独裁者、暴君与威权统治者的亲近，过去大约10年里一直令民主国家的领导人和外交官感到困惑，也重新塑造了美国的外交政策。他对朝鲜的金正恩（“我们坠入了爱河”）、埃及的阿卜杜勒-法塔赫·塞西（“我最喜欢的独裁者”）、沙特阿拉伯的穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼（“我太喜欢他了”）、土耳其的雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安（“我的一个非常好的朋友”）以及萨尔瓦多的纳伊布·布克尔（“一位了不起的总统”）等人赞不绝口。 By contrast, he regularly feuds with leaders of traditional allies like Canada, Britain, France, Germany and Italy. He derided the democratically elected president of Ukraine, Volodymyr Zelensky, last year as a “dictator without elections” while offering no concerns about Mr. Putin, whose elections have been documented as thoroughly rigged. He had the United States vote along with North Korea, Belarus and Sudan last year against a U.N. resolution condemning Russia’s invasion of Ukraine and lately has been courting Belarus’s dictator Aleksandr G. Lukashenko. 与此形成鲜明对比的是，他时常与加拿大、英国、法国、德国、意大利等传统盟友的领导人爆发争执。去年，他嘲讽乌克兰民选总统泽连斯基是“一个未经选举的独裁者”，却未对普京表达过类似担忧，而后者的历次选举早已被证实为彻头彻尾地舞弊操纵。去年，他曾让美国与朝鲜、白俄罗斯、苏丹一道投票反对一项谴责俄罗斯入侵乌克兰的联合国决议，而最近更是开始向白俄罗斯独裁者亚历山大·卢卡申科示好。 周四，记者团正在等待特朗普和习近平，而各大广播网仍在抵制该记者团，直到特朗普的工作人员以书面形式承诺让CNN的摄像机重回轮值。 At home, Mr. Trump regularly battles the domestic news media, denouncing journalists as “enemies of the people,” a phrase used by Stalin to condemn dissidents to the gulag. More than any American president in modern times, Mr. Trump has mounted a wide-ranging campaign against independent media through multibillion-dollar lawsuits, Federal Communications Commission pressure, subpoenas to reporters, the eviction of The Associated Press from the White House press pool and restrictions that effectively forced reporters out of the Pentagon. 在国内，特朗普经常与美国新闻媒体交战，斥责记者是“人民的敌人”——斯大林曾用这一说法给异见人士定罪，将他们送进古拉格。与现代任何一位美国总统相比，特朗普针对独立媒体发起的打压行动范围都更加广泛，包括索赔数十亿美元的诉讼、通过联邦通信委员会施压、向记者发出传票、将美联社逐出白宫记者团，以及施加实质上迫使记者离开五角大楼的限制措施。 Mr. Trump seemed unbothered on Thursday by any mixed messages sent by welcoming Chinese state reporters at the same time he was trying to throw out American news outlets as part of what he called his “ban on the free press.” On the other hand, he did seem bothered by the fact that the still-unresolved showdown meant that boycotting network television cameras did not beam the festivities to the nation. 周四，特朗普似乎并不在意这样做释放出的矛盾信号：一边欢迎中国官方媒体记者，一边又试图把美国新闻机构赶出去——他把自己的做法称为“对自由媒体的禁令”。不过，另一方面，他似乎的确对这场仍未解决的对峙所造成的结果感到不满：参与抵制的电视网没有用摄像机把这些盛大场面传向全国。 In a social media post late in the day, Mr. Trump praised Mr. Xi as “the Highly Respected President of China” and flattered “his beautiful wife, Madam Peng” while accusing CNN and MS NOW of having “NO CREDIBILITY” and being “Fake News.” A White House pool report indicated that at one point during the day Mr. Trump “made a joke about how the Chinese had the friendliest press corps.” 当天晚些时候，特朗普在社交媒体发帖，称赞习近平是“备受尊敬的中国国家主席”，还恭维“他美丽的妻子彭女士”，与此同时，他指责CNN和MS NOW“毫无公信力”，是“假新闻”。白宫记者团的一篇报道显示，当天特朗普曾“开玩笑说，中国拥有最友好的记者团”。 Which of course depends on the definition of friendly. China exercises iron-fisted control over its press corps and has at least 111 journalists and media workers locked up, according to Reporters Without Borders, making it “the world’s largest prison for journalists.” Of the 180 countries that the group ranks on freedom of the press, China ranks almost at rock bottom at 178th place, above only North Korea and Eritrea. (The United States has fallen to 64th under Mr. Trump.) 当然，这取决于怎么定义“友好”。中国对新闻媒体实行铁腕控制。据无国界记者组织统计，中国至少关押了111名记者和媒体工作者，因此成为“世界上关押记者最多的国家”。在该组织对180个国家的新闻自由度排名中，中国几乎垫底，位列第178名，仅高于朝鲜和厄立特里亚。（特朗普执政下的美国已跌至第64位。） “Trump doesn’t just want to meet with Xi — he wants to copy him,” Senator Chris Coons, Democrat of Delaware and a senior member of the Senate Foreign Relations Committee, wrote on social media, citing attacks on the press, politicizing the justice system and purging the civil service. “特朗普不仅仅是想与习近平会面——他还想效仿他，”特拉华州民主党参议员、参议院外交关系委员会资深成员克里斯·库恩斯在社交媒体上写道，并列举了其打压新闻媒体、将司法系统政治化、清洗公务员队伍等种种行径作为佐证。 Even some Republicans, while not openly questioning Mr. Trump’s media ban, expressed disappointment that the president, in courting the leader of one of America’s largest trading partners, was so willing to flatter and fete Mr. Xi while overlooking China’s record of government oppression. 甚至一些共和党人也表达了失望。虽然他们没有公开质疑特朗普针对媒体的禁令，但他们认为，在争取美国最大贸易伙伴之一的领导人时，总统如此乐于奉承、盛情款待习近平，却对中国政府的压迫记录视而不见，令人失望。 “During every minute of dialogue, our commander in chief should keep in mind that his guest is a brutal, unelected and oppressive dictator who seeks to dominate his neighbors and whose massive military arsenal is aimed directly at the United States of America,” said Senator Roger Wicker of Mississippi, the Republican chairman of the Senate Armed Services Committee. “在每一分钟的对话中，我们的三军统帅都应该牢记，他的客人是一名残暴、未经选举产生、实行压迫统治的独裁者，他试图支配邻国，而且其庞大的军事武库直接瞄准美利坚合众国，”密西西比州共和党参议员、参议院军事委员会主席罗杰·威克说。 That was not, however, the message being emphasized at the White House, where the president’s aides this week sought to replace the news outlets he tried to bar by kicking off their own online “Trump TV,” a form of state television that Mr. Xi might recognize. That is certainly one way for Mr. Trump to have his own friendliest press corps. 然而，这并非白宫方面所着力传递的信息。本周，总统的助手们试图通过推出自己的在线“特朗普电视”来取代他试图封杀的新闻媒体——这是习近平可能不会陌生的国家电视台形式。对特朗普来说，这当然是一种拥有属于自己的“最友好记者团”的办法。 Peter Baker是《纽约时报》首席白宫记者。特朗普是他报道的第六任美国总统，有时他也撰写将总统和美国政府置于更宏观的背景和历史框架下的分析性文章。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site

Reporters from CNN, MS NOW and Politico who were initially barred from entering the White House on Thursday morning despite a court order were allowed in later in the day , but by late afternoon Mr. Trump’s staff had still not permitted CNN back into the pool that provides footage of the president every day. 习近平在白宫受到隆重欢迎，但美国的各家电视网却没有报道这一盛况，因为它们仍在 抵制白宫记者团 ，直到特朗普的工作人员以书面形式承诺让CNN的摄像机重回轮值。周四上午，尽管有法院命令，CNN、MS NOW和Politico的记者起初仍被禁止进入白宫； 当天晚些时候，他们获准进入 。但截至下午晚些时候，特朗普的工作人员仍未允许CNN重新加入每日拍摄总统日常活动、供各方共享画面的记者团。 Even as Mr. Trump fumed that his carefully orchestrated day of pageantry was not shown on air, he basked in Mr. Xi’s presence and lavished him with praise, making no mention of human rights issues that past presidents raised when meeting with Chinese counterparts. 尽管特朗普对自己精心筹划的这场盛大仪式未能在电视上播出而大为光火，但他仍陶醉于中国领导人的到场，并对其大加赞美，只字未提历任总统在会晤中国领导人时通常都会提及的人权议题。 “From the time of my first election in 2016, President Xi and I have forged a friendship, a truly great friendship, actually, built on mutual respect and the vital interests of our people,” Mr. Trump said in the Grand Foyer of the White House. He later delighted in taking his great friend on a tour of the new White House ballroom that is under construction and showed off his taunting photograph of an autopen meant to represent his predecessor, former President Joseph R. Biden Jr. “自2016年我首次当选以来，我和习主席打造了友谊关系，一段真正伟大的友谊，这段友谊建立在相互尊重和我们的人民的共同利益之上，”特朗普在白宫的主门厅说道。后来，他兴致勃勃地带着这位好友参观正在施工的新白宫宴会厅，还得意地向其展示了一张带有嘲讽意味的照片，照片中是一个自动签名笔，用以影射他的前任拜登总统。 特朗普向习近平展示了一张带有嘲讽意味的照片，照片中是一个自动签名笔，用以影射他的前任拜登总统。 Mr. Trump hopes to similarly host Mr. Putin soon. Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced this week that Mr. Trump had invited the once-ostracized Russian leader to attend the annual Group of 20 meeting in Miami in December, which would be his first appearance at the annual gathering since 2019, before his full-fledged invasion of Ukraine. The summit is scheduled to be held at Trump National Doral Miami, where the president tried to host a Group of 7 meeting in his first term only to back down after Republican complaints that it was too self-dealing — complaints not heard this time. 特朗普希望不久后也能以类似方式接待普京。国务卿鲁比奥 本周宣布 ，特朗普已经邀请这位一度遭到国际社会排斥的俄罗斯领导人出席12月在迈阿密举行的二十国集团年度峰会。如果成行，这将是普京自2019年——即其全面入侵乌克兰之前——以来首次出席这一年度聚会。峰会计划在特朗普国家多拉尔迈阿密度假村举行。特朗普第一个任期内曾试图在那里举办七国集团峰会，却 因共和党内部批评此举涉嫌以权谋私而作罢 ，而这一次，这样的抱怨声却没有出现。 While Mr. Putin was kicked out of the G7 and other groups because of his seizure of Crimea in 2014, Mr. Trump has been eager to bring him back into the international fold. The International Criminal Court issued an arrest warrant for Mr. Putin on war crimes charges in 2023, but Mr. Trump ignored that by inviting the Russian to Alaska last year — and just this week denounced the court in an address to the U.N. General Assembly as “an evil group of people” as his administration attempts to dismantle the body. 普京因为2014年吞并克里米亚而被逐出七国集团及其他国际组织，但特朗普一直热衷于让他重新融入国际社会。国际刑事法院2023年以战争罪指控对普京发出逮捕令，但特朗普对此置之不理，去年还邀请这位俄罗斯领导人前往阿拉斯加。就在本周，他又在联合国大会发表讲话时斥责该法院是“一群邪恶的人”，而他的政府目前正试图搞垮该机构。 Mr. Trump’s affinity for despots, tyrants and autocrats has baffled democratic leaders and diplomats and reoriented American foreign policy for some 10 years now. He gushes over the likes of Kim Jong-un of North Korea (“we fell in love”), Abdel Fattah el-Sisi of Egypt (“my favorite dictator”), Mohammed bin Salman of Saudi Arabia (“I like him too much”), Recep Tayyip Erdogan of Turkey (“a very good friend of mine”) and Nayib Bukele of El Salvador (“one hell of a president”). 特朗普对独裁者、暴君与威权统治者的亲近，过去大约10年里一直令民主国家的领导人和外交官感到困惑，也重新塑造了美国的外交政策。他对朝鲜的金正恩（“我们坠入了爱河”）、埃及的阿卜杜勒-法塔赫·塞西（“我最喜欢的独裁者”）、沙特阿拉伯的穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼（“我太喜欢他了”）、土耳其的雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安（“我的一个非常好的朋友”）以及萨尔瓦多的纳伊布·布克尔（“一位了不起的总统”）等人赞不绝口。 By contrast, he regularly feuds with leaders of traditional allies like Canada, Britain, France, Germany and Italy. He derided the democratically elected president of Ukraine, Volodymyr Zelensky, last year as a “dictator without elections” while offering no concerns about Mr. Putin, whose elections have been documented as thoroughly rigged. He had the United States vote along with North Korea, Belarus and Sudan last year against a U.N. resolution condemning Russia’s invasion of Ukraine and lately has been courting Belarus’s dictator Aleksandr G. Lukashenko. 与此形成鲜明对比的是，他时常与加拿大、英国、法国、德国、意大利等传统盟友的领导人爆发争执。去年，他嘲讽乌克兰民选总统泽连斯基是“一个未经选举的独裁者”，却未对普京表达过类似担忧，而后者的历次选举早已被证实为彻头彻尾地舞弊操纵。去年，他曾让美国与朝鲜、白俄罗斯、苏丹一道 投票反对 一项谴责俄罗斯入侵乌克兰的联合国决议，而最近更是开始 向白俄罗斯独裁者亚历山大·卢卡申科示好 。 周四，记者团正在等待特朗普和习近平，而各大广播网仍在抵制该记者团，直到特朗普的工作人员以书面形式承诺让CNN的摄像机重回轮值。 At home, Mr. Trump regularly battles the domestic news media, denouncing journalists as “enemies of the people,” a phrase used by Stalin to condemn dissidents to the gulag. More than any American president in modern times, Mr. Trump has mounted a wide-ranging campaign against independent media through multibillion-dollar lawsuits, Federal Communications Commission pressure, subpoenas to reporters, the eviction of The Associated Press from the White House press pool and restrictions that effectively forced reporters out of the Pentagon. 在国内，特朗普经常与美国新闻媒体交战，斥责记者是“人民的敌人”——斯大林曾用这一说法给异见人士定罪，将他们送进古拉格。与现代任何一位美国总统相比，特朗普针对独立媒体发起的打压行动范围都更加广泛，包括索赔数十亿美元的诉讼、通过联邦通信委员会施压、向记者发出传票、将美联社逐出白宫记者团，以及施加实质上迫使记者离开五角大楼的限制措施。 Mr. Trump seemed unbothered on Thursday by any mixed messages sent by welcoming Chinese state reporters at the same time he was trying to throw out American news outlets as part of what he called his “ban on the free press.” On the other hand, he did seem bothered by the fact that the still-unresolved showdown meant that boycotting network television cameras did not beam the festivities to the nation. 周四，特朗普似乎并不在意这样做释放出的矛盾信号：一边欢迎中国官方媒体记者，一边又试图把美国新闻机构赶出去——他把自己的做法称为“对自由媒体的禁令”。不过，另一方面，他似乎的确对这场仍未解决的对峙所造成的结果感到不满：参与抵制的电视网没有用摄像机把这些盛大场面传向全国。 In a social media post late in the day, Mr. Trump praised Mr. Xi as “the Highly Respected President of China” and flattered “his beautiful wife, Madam Peng” while accusing CNN and MS NOW of having “NO CREDIBILITY” and being “Fake News.” A White House pool report indicated that at one point during the day Mr. Trump “made a joke about how the Chinese had the friendliest press corps.” 当天晚些时候，特朗普在社交媒体 发帖 ，称赞习近平是“备受尊敬的中国国家主席”，还恭维“他美丽的妻子彭女士”，与此同时，他指责CNN和MS NOW“毫无公信力”，是“假新闻”。白宫记者团的一篇 报道 显示，当天特朗普曾“开玩笑说，中国拥有最友好的记者团”。 Which of course depends on the definition of friendly. China exercises iron-fisted control over its press corps and has at least 111 journalists and media workers locked up, according to Reporters Without Borders , making it “the world’s largest prison for journalists.” Of the 180 countries that the group ranks on freedom of the press, China ranks almost at rock bottom at 178th place, above only North Korea and Eritrea. (The United States has fallen to 64th under Mr. Trump.) 当然，这取决于怎么定义“友好”。中国对新闻媒体实行铁腕控制。据 无国界记者组织 统计，中国至少关押了111名记者和媒体工作者，因此成为“世界上关押记者最多的国家”。在该组织对180个国家的新闻自由度排名中，中国几乎垫底，位列第178名，仅高于朝鲜和厄立特里亚。（特朗普执政下的美国已跌至第64位。） “Trump doesn’t just want to meet with Xi — he wants to copy him,” Senator Chris Coons, Democrat of Delaware and a senior member of the Senate Foreign Relations Committee, wrote on social media , citing attacks on the press, politicizing the justice system and purging the civil service. “特朗普不仅仅是想与习近平会面——他还想效仿他，”特拉华州民主党参议员、参议院外交关系委员会资深成员克里斯·库恩斯 在社交媒体上写道 ，并列举了其打压新闻媒体、将司法系统政治化、清洗公务员队伍等种种行径作为佐证。 Even some Republicans, while not openly questioning Mr. Trump’s media ban, expressed disappointment that the president, in courting the leader of one of America’s largest trading partners, was so willing to flatter and fete Mr. Xi while overlooking China’s record of government oppression. 甚至一些共和党人也表达了失望。虽然他们没有公开质疑特朗普针对媒体的禁令，但他们认为，在争取美国最大贸易伙伴之一的领导人时，总统如此乐于奉承、盛情款待习近平，却对中国政府的压迫记录视而不见，令人失望。 “During every minute of dialogue, our commander in chief should keep in mind that his guest is a brutal, unelected and oppressive dictator who seeks to dominate his neighbors and whose massive military arsenal is aimed directly at the United States of America,” said Senator Roger Wicker of Mississippi, the Republican chairman of the Senate Armed Services Committee. “在每一分钟的对话中，我们的三军统帅都应该牢记，他的客人是一名残暴、未经选举产生、实行压迫统治的独裁者，他试图支配邻国，而且其庞大的军事武库直接瞄准美利坚合众国，”密西西比州共和党参议员、参议院军事委员会主席 罗杰·威克 说。 That was not, however, the message being emphasized at the White House, where the president’s aides this week sought to replace the news outlets he tried to bar by kicking off their own online “Trump TV,” a form of state television that Mr. Xi might recognize. That is certainly one way for Mr. Trump to have his own friendliest press corps. 然而，这并非白宫方面所着力传递的信息。本周，总统的助手们试图通过推出自己的在线“特朗普电视”来取代他试图封杀的新闻媒体——这是习近平可能不会陌生的国家电视台形式。对特朗普来说，这当然是一种拥有属于自己的“最友好记者团”的办法。 Peter Baker 是《纽约时报》首席白宫记者。特朗普是他报道的第六任美国总统，有时他也撰写将总统和美国政府置于更宏观的背景和历史框架下的分析性文章。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site

title: “习特会”国宴菜单：芝麻脆皮海鲈鱼和爽脆嫩白菜
description: LEO SANDS2026年9月25日特朗普总统将于周四晚为中国国家主席习近平举行国宴。 Kenny Holston/The New York Times President Trump and the first lady, Melania Trump, are preparing to host President Xi Jinping of China for a state dinner in the East Room of the White House on Thursday evening. 特朗普总统与第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普正准备于周四晚在白宫东厅为中国国家主席习近平举行国宴。 According to the three-course menu released by the White House, the dishes were chosen to emphasize American ingredients with a “subtle Chinese influence.” 根据白宫公布的三道菜菜单，菜品的选择主要展示美国食材，同时“巧妙融入中国元素”。 Chefs will serve Mr. Trump, Mr. Xi and other guests a main course of sesame-crusted sea bass and crisp baby bok choy. The yellow squash appetizer will be drizzled with scallion oil. According to the White House, the dishes bring “the culinary traditions of both nations together.” 厨师将为特朗普、习近平和其他宾客奉上一道以芝麻脆皮海鲈鱼和爽脆嫩白菜为主的主菜。作为前菜的黄南瓜浓汤将淋上葱油。白宫称，这些菜品将“两国的烹饪传统融为一体”。 The East Room tables will be laid with red linens and its urns filled with red blossoms, which the administration said was a reference to the color’s significance in China. “The décor for the evening is an expression of warmth and celebration,” it said. 东厅的餐桌将铺上红色桌布，花器也将插满红花。政府表示，这一布置是为了呼应红色在中国文化中的特殊意义。“当晚的装饰体现了热情与喜庆的氛围，”白宫表示。 Diners will begin their meal by toasting with a glass of Schramsberg. That is the California sparkling wine that President Richard M. Nixon drank in 1972 during his visit to Beijing, which heralded a historic thaw in U.S.-Chinese relations. 晚宴将以世酿伯格酒庄的气泡酒祝酒开场。1972年，尼克松总统访问北京时喝的正是这款加州起泡酒。那次访问开启了美中关系历史性的破冰。 First Course 第一道菜 Yellow squash velouté 黄南瓜浓汤 Wild mushroom fricassee 野菇烩菜 Crispy pancetta 香脆意式培根 Scallion oil 香葱油 Second Course 第二道菜 Sesame-crusted sea bass 芝麻脆皮海鲈鱼 Braised baby bok choy 炖嫩白菜 Roasted garden eggplant 烤园圃茄子 Sauce verte 青酱 Dessert 甜点 Vanilla crémeux and White House honey ice cream 香草奶油慕斯配白宫蜂蜜冰淇淋 Walnut frangipane 核桃杏仁奶油饼 Sour cherry confit 酸樱桃果酱 Entertainment 表演 The opera singer Christopher Macchio, who performed this month at the Republican midterm convention in Dallas, will headline the evening’s musical lineup. 男高音歌唱家克里斯托弗·马基奥将领衔当晚的音乐演出。本月，他曾在达拉斯举行的共和党中期选举大会上献唱。 Musicians from the U.S. Army and Marine Corps will also perform. 美国陆军和海军陆战队的的军乐团也将献演。 Leo Sands是《纽约时报》突发新闻中心记者，常驻伦敦。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 特朗普与习近平在白宫会面，外界对峰会成果预期较低
description: ZOLAN KANNO-YOUNGS, DAVID E. SANGER, ANTON TROIANOVSKI2026年9月25日 Haiyun Jiang/The New York Times President Trump greeted President Xi Jinping of China at a lavish White House arrival ceremony on Thursday morning, with the two leaders striking different tones in their opening remarks at a landmark U.S.-China summit that is likely to be full of pomp but unlikely to produce significant agreements. 周四上午，特朗普总统在一场奢华的白宫欢迎仪式上迎接中国国家主席习近平。这场具有里程碑意义的美中元首峰会可能充满盛大仪式，却不太可能达成重大协议，两位领导人在开场致辞中展现出截然不同的基调。 Mr. Trump emphasized the “truly great friendship” between the two leaders after they and their spouses met on a red carpet outside the White House. Mr. Xi’s opening remarks were less personal: The Chinese leader thanked the Trumps for their hospitality before turning to matters of geopolitics, including Chinese companies’ access to the United States. 在两位领导人及夫人在白宫外的红毯会面后，特朗普强调了两人之间“真正伟大的友谊”。习近平的开场致辞则没有那么个人化：这位中国领导人感谢了特朗普夫妇的盛情款待，随后转向地缘政治问题，包括中国企业进入美国市场等问题。 “The interests of China and the United States are deeply intertwined,” Mr. Xi said. The two nations, he said, must avoid the “Thucydides trap” — the theory that a rising power and an established power are likely to go to war. “中美两国利益深度交融，”习近平说。他表示，两国必须避免“修昔底德陷阱”——即新兴大国和老牌强国可能会爆发战争的理论。 Mr. Xi also announced that his country would be sending two pandas to the Atlanta zoo in the coming days as he invoked Mr. Trump’s oft-used slogan: “Achieving the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation and making America great again can go hand in hand.” 习近平还宣布，中国将在未来几天向亚特兰大动物园送去两只大熊猫，他还引用了特朗普经常使用的口号，称“实现中华民族伟大复兴和让美国再次伟大并行不悖”。 The White House visit, Mr. Xi’s first in more than a decade, opened with elaborate ceremonies involving hundreds of U.S. military personnel and a B-2 stealth bomber flyover. On Thursday evening, Mr. Trump is set to host a state dinner in Mr. Xi’s honor. 这次白宫之行是习近平十余年来的首次到访，行程以精心设计的仪式拉开帷幕，数百名美国军人参与欢迎仪式，一架B-2隐形轰炸机飞越现场。周四晚间，特朗普将为习近平举办国宴。 But expectations are low for breakthroughs in resolving any of the major tensions between the world’s two most powerful countries. Those include a shaky trade-war truce, the fate of Taiwan, a risky A.I. race and China’s support for Iran and for Russia’s war against Ukraine. 但对于这两个世界上最强大国家能否在任何重大矛盾方面取得突破，外界的期望并不高。其中包括不稳定的贸易战休战、台湾的命运、人工智能竞争的风险，以及中国对伊朗以及俄罗斯战争的支持。 In a sign of the incremental nature of the two countries’ negotiations, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said late Wednesday that the United States and China had agreed to extend a one-year trade truce by two months, to Jan. 10. It had been due to expire Nov. 10. 美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特于周三晚间表示，美中已同意将为期一年的贸易停火协议延长两个月，至1月10日。该协议原定于11月10日到期。这体现了两国之间谈判的渐进性质。 Nor do experts expect much headway on artificial intelligence safety issues, despite American complaints about Chinese A.I. practices and even though some of America’s biggest tech titans have been invited to the dinner Thursday. 尽管美国对中国的人工智能行业做法有所抱怨，但专家们也不认为两国会在人工智能安全问题上取得太大进展。尽管一些美国最大的科技巨头已被邀请参加周四的晚宴。 Mr. Xi, for his part, could take advantage of Mr. Trump’s efforts to maintain a good relationship by pressing him to continue delaying arms sales to Taiwan. 就习近平而言，他可能会利用特朗普维护良好关系的努力向其施压，要求他继续推迟对台湾的军售。 Here’s what else to know: 以下是其他需要了解的内容： • First lady: Melania Trump is scheduled to take Mr. Xi’s wife, Peng Liyuan, to the Smithsonian National Museum of Asian Art after Thursday’s arrival ceremony. On Friday, the women will join their husbands for tea in the Red Room of the White House and for a tour of the National Archives. • 第一夫人：梅拉尼娅·特朗普计划在周四的欢迎仪式后陪同习近平的夫人彭丽媛前往史密森尼国家亚洲艺术博物馆。周五，两位夫人将陪同他们的丈夫在白宫红厅共进下午茶，并参观国家档案馆。 • Americans detained: The families of two Americans listed by the U.S. government as wrongfully detained in China are urging Mr. Trump to press Mr. Xi for their release. They are Youlin Chen, a seismologist who was detained and accused of spying while visiting relatives in Beijing in 2024, and U Min Zin, a political scientist who was arrested in June while visiting southwest China to attend a conference at the invitation of the Chinese government. • 被拘押的美国人：被美国政府列为在中国被错误拘押的两名美国人的家属正敦促特朗普向习近平施压，促成他们的释放。两人分别是陈友麟，一位于2024年在北京探亲时被拘押并被指控从事间谍活动的地质学家；以及敏辛，一位于6月受中国政府邀请前往中国西南地区参加会议时被逮捕的政治学家。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。
